reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const repo = 'acme/api'; const pages = []; let page = 1; while (page) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo,state:'open',label:'bug',page}); pages.push(...result.items); page = result.next_page; } const candidates = pages.filter(issue => issue.comments > 5); const search = await tools.search_issues({q:'repo:acme/api is:open label:bug no:assignee'}); const unmatched = candidates.filter(issue => !search.items.some(hit => hit.number === issue.number)); return {total:pages.length, candidates:candidates.length, matched:candidates.length-unmatched.length, unmatched:unmatched.map(issue=>issue.number), detail:unmatched.length ? await tools.get_issue({repo,number:unmatched[0].number}) : null};","answer":""}
